verdict.rationale: SigNoz is open-source, self-hostable, and built on OpenTelemetry standards, with data stored in ClickHouse and dashboards exportable as JSON, which supports data portability and open formats. However, there's no explicit documentation of a full bulk data export mechanism (traces/logs/metrics) for migrating away, and part of the product is open-core (ee/ licensed separately per community reports), which complicates a clean 'export everything and leave' story. missing for 10: explicit bulk export/backup tooling for traces-logs-metrics, clarity on ee-only features not being portable, independent confirmation of successful full data migration out of SigNoz.
